newsitem.title: EU: 271251 DED - BC-DIARY-WEEKLY EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, MARCH 31 - SUNDAY, APRIL 6.
newsitem.headline: 271251 DED - BC-DIARY-WEEKLY EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, MARCH 31 - SUNDAY, APRIL 6.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
MONDAY, MARCH 31
Easter Monday - EU institutions closed; no events scheduled.
TUESDAY, APRIL 1
No events scheduled.
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 2
BRUSSELS - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting.
Provisional agenda includes:
- Commissioner Flynn green paper on new ways to organise work.
- Commissioner Kinnock communication on airport dangers.
- Commissioners Bangemann and Van Miert communication on shipbuilding policy - first reflections on future options.
BRUSSELS - Swedish Ministry of Environment holds seminar on "Chemicals, environment and human health" (1530/1330 GMT). Venue: Sweden's permanent representation to the EU, Square de Meeus 30.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - EP Foreign Affairs Committee meets at 1500/1300 GMT. European Commissioner Emma Bonino attends to discuss the situation in Albania.
BELFAST (NEW ITEM) - EP Fisheries Committee meets at 1400/1300 GMT.
THURSDAY, APRIL 3

DUBAI - The Dubai conference on the Euro-Arab peace process to further cooperation between two regions (To April 5). Main issues discussed are water resources management, energy management, high tech industrial cooperation and information technology, privatisation and private sector promotion. Contact: Sunil John, PanGulf Public Relations (9714) 219065.
BELFAST (NEW ITEM) - EP Fisheries Committee meets at 0900/0800 GMT.
FRIDAY, APRIL 4

NOORDWIJK, Netherlands - Informal ECOFIN Council (To April 6). (possibly) Discussions on regulations for EMU stability pact, legal framework for the euro and ERM 2. Ministers look at designs for euro coin ahead of formal decision by EU leaders in June.
BELFAST (NEW ITEM) - EP Fisheries Committees meets at 0900/0800 GMT.
SATURDAY, APRIL 5
BELFAST (NEW ITEM) - EP Fisheries Committee meets at 0900/0800 GMT.
SUNDAY, APRIL 6

MAASTRICHT (EXPANDED ITEM) - Informal Culture Council (To April 8). International group of intellectuals meets to discuss the meaning of culture in society (Sunday). Discussions on cultural paragraph in the EC Treaty, book prices and the future of public television (Monday-Tuesday).
NOORWIJK, Netherlands (NEW ITEM) - Dutch Presidency holds a conclave of foreign ministers on the Inter-Governmental Conference (To April 7).
